title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Note-Taking in Real-Time Listening
prompt: In many university courses and professional settings, people must listen to spoken information in real time—such as lectures, meetings, or phone conversations—and record key details accurately. Some argue that relying on digital tools and automatic transcription reduces the need for individuals to develop strong note-taking skills, while others believe that personal note-taking remains essential for comprehension and memory. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请针对题目中的两种观点进行讨论，并明确给出你自己的立场。建议先规划文章结构：引言段引出话题并表明立场；主体段分别讨论双方观点并给出理由和例子；结论段总结并重申你的观点。注意使用恰当的学术词汇和复杂句式，确保段落之间逻辑连贯。写作时请控制在40分钟以内，字数不少于250词。
